files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added
- Sessions: up to 8 photos and videos per session instead of one of each. A new upload is added to the others instead of replacing them.
- Sessions, spots and equipment: a star picks the photo (or, for a session, the video) that is featured: it comes first and is the one shown in the lists (web and Android). The sessions table shows it with the number of other photos and videos.
- Shared links of a session: all its photos and videos, the featured one first.
- Sessions table: a click on a row opens the session for editing, like a tap on a session in the Android app.
- Forms (sessions, spots, equipment…): a back arrow next to the title returns to the list, like in the Android app.
- API: `/api/v1/version` gives the version of the app and of the Android app that goes with it. From Android 1.7.0, an older Android app offers its update on opening (links to Codeberg and F-Droid).

### Security
- Uploads (photos, videos, GPS tracks and track analysis) are limited per user and per hour (120 photos or videos, 60 tracks), high enough for normal use and the Android app's sync, to stop an upload loop.
- Shared links: videos no longer give away where they were filmed. The GPS position stored by phones is erased when a video is uploaded, without re-encoding it (the "Hide the exact position of the spot" option of shared links now also covers the video), and on the first view of a video uploaded before this version. A photo whose preview cannot be generated is no longer served as the original file, which could contain its position.
